senses.gloss:
नैवसंज्ञानासंज्ञायतन नैवसञ्ज्ञानासञ्ज्ञा-
यतन, अम्, n. a place (आयतन) where there is
no (न-एव) thinking (सञ्ज्ञान) and no (न) not-
thinking (अ-सञ्ज्ञा).

नैव-सञ्ज्ञा-समाधि, इस्, m. meditation in
which there is no reflection.

नैवार नैवार, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. नीवार), con-
sisting in or made of wild rice.

नैविद नैविद, अस्, ई, अम्, having a Ni-
vid (q. v.).

नैवेद्य नैवेद्य, अम्, n. (fr. नि-वेद्य), an
offering of eatables presented to a deity or idol
(which may afterwards be distributed to his ministers
or worshippers, especially if presented to any form
of Viṣṇu).

नैवेशिक नैवेशिक, अम्, n. (fr. नि-वेश),
any vessel or implement belonging to the furniture
of a house; a present to a Brāhman householder, a
girl so given, or ornaments with her, &c.
